title: Sandcastle on Camelot on 30A's Seagrove Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This newly completed, regal four-story vacation home located on Scenic 30A boasts five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, and can comfortably accommodate up to 16 privileged guests. Its prime location in Seagrove Beach places it just a stone
description_expanded: This newly completed, regal four-story vacation home located on Scenic 30A boasts five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, and can comfortably accommodate up to 16 privileged guests. Its prime location in Seagrove Beach places it just a stone's throw from the pristine sugar-sand beach and an exotic coastal dune lake. Additionally, it is situated directly across from a large community swimming pool, which is surrounded by tropical palm trees, offering the ultimate relaxation experience. Sandcastle on Camelot abounds with creature comforts, complemented by additional living spaces that create an ideal setting for a beach reunion, catering to multiple families. On the first floor, one of these spaces features a queen-size Murphy bed and a queen-size sleeper sofa, accommodating up to four guests. Adjacent to a well-furnished den is a kitchenette equipped with a wet bar and a dining area. A second dining area is situated on a covered patio with an outdoor kitchen, perfect for hosting enjoyable family gatherings. Additionally, a hall bath with a walk-in shower offers convenience for rinsing off sand after a swim at the pool or beach. On the second floor, you'll find the four guest bedrooms, accompanied by a bonus living area. This space is equipped with a wet bar boasting a wine cooler and a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV for entertainment. The bedrooms, adorned in bright, crisp nautical decor, feature upscale furnishings in navy blues and whites. Two of these bedrooms offer king-size beds and ensuite luxury baths with marble-tiled walk-in showers. The remaining two bedrooms are well-suited for accommodating two families, with one offering a king-sized bed and a twin bunk, while the other provides a queen-size bed. These guest quarters conveniently share a connected bath outfitted with a tub-shower combination. Ascending to the third floor, you'll discover the main open living, dining, and kitchen area, alongside the primary bedroom suite. Sunlit windows flood the space with natural light, while glass doors beckon to a balcony beyond. A cozy ensemble, comprising a wraparound couch, two blue/white striped accent chairs, and a pair of elegant armchairs, surrounds a wall-mounted flat-screen TV for entertainment. The open kitchen boasts state-of-the-art brushed stainless steel appliances, including a spacious gas range oven and refrigerator freezer. White custom cabinetry is set off by a gleaming sky-blue brick backsplash and quartz countertops, featuring an entertainment bar with four plush blue chairs. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area offers a convenient wet bar complete with a wine glass rack. A rectangular honey-toned hardwood table, paired with ten tropical bamboo-framed chairs sporting white woven rope seating, sets the stage for memorable meals. Adjacent to the common areas, the handsomely styled primary bedroom boasts a king-size bed, a cozy seating area, a Gulf-view private balcony, and a luxurious ensuite bath adorned with marble tile. This opulent bath features double vanity sinks, a spacious walk-in shower, and a deep soaking tub, ensuring indulgent comfort for guests. The final floor features a landing atop a staircase that beckons you to a rooftop deck offering breathtaking Gulf views. Here, you can immerse yourself in the serene beauty of the coastal surroundings while dining alfresco. The deck is adorned with an outdoor dining table, inviting you to savor delicious meals against the backdrop of the shimmering Gulf waters. Additionally, plush lounge chairs provide the perfect spot to unwind, whether you're basking in the warmth of the sun or stargazing under the night sky. Nearby this outstanding Seagrove Beach locale lies both Eastern Lake and Deer Lake , two coastal dune lakes that are rare treasures, scarcely found elsewhere in the world. The unique blend of salted artisan spring water within these lakes nurtures a diverse array of wildlife, waterfowl, and fish, adding to the allure of the area. Just a stone's throw away, the enchanting coastal village of Rosemary Beach awaits, characterized by its charming Dutch West Indies Colonial-style architecture, quaint village lawns, picturesque fountains, and meticulously manicured landscaping. A European-styled avenue gracefully winds its way through the dunes, leading visitors to the pristine shores. Within the village, a delightful array of amenities awaits discovery, including fine restaurants, inviting wine bistros, fashionable boutiques, specialty shops, and captivating galleries. Throughout the year, Rosemary Beach comes alive with vibrant festivals hosted on the village lawns, featuring an array of golden Americana-styled family events, outdoor concerts, and seasonal fireworks displays. Treat yourself like royalty at Sandcastle on Camelot , where each moment unfolds like a chapter in your own beachside fairy tale! First Floor:   Bonus Den with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Queen Murphy Bed + Patio Access, Kitchenette, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower. Second Floor: Bonus Den with Wet Bar, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, King Bedroom with Twin Bunk, Jack-n-Jill Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom, Laundry. Third Floor: Living Room with Wet Bar and Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Powder Room. Fourth Floor: Landing with Balcony Access.
